plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for D-Link switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 171), plus temperature sensors, fan and power-supply state on DGS-1250 series (DLINKSW-ENTITY-EXT-MIB).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the five-minute CPU utilization of the D-Link DGS/DXS switch (agentCPUutilizationIn5min) as a 0-100 percentage. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, forwarding instability, or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_5s
metrics.description: This metric reports the five-second CPU utilization of the D-Link DGS/DXS switch (agentCPUutilizationIn5sec) as a 0-100 percentage. It is a short-window companion to the five-minute headline CPU metric.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_1min
metrics.description: This metric reports the one-minute CPU utilization of the D-Link DGS/DXS switch (agentCPUutilizationIn1min) as a 0-100 percentage. It is a mid-window companion to the five-minute headline CPU metric.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total DRAM of the D-Link DGS/DXS switch in bytes (agentDRAMutilizationTotalDRAM, converted from kilobytes). Rows are indexed by unitID (0 = local device).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the used DRAM of the D-Link DGS/DXS switch in bytes (agentDRAMutilizationUsedDRAM, converted from kilobytes). Rows are indexed by unitID (0 = local device).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports DRAM utilization of the D-Link DGS/DXS switch (agentDRAMutilization) as a 0-100 percentage. Rows are indexed by unitID (0 = local device). High memory usage may indicate leaks, oversized MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature reading of each DGS-1250 hardware sensor (dEntityExtEnvTempCurrent) in degrees Celsius. Values outside −40..125 ℃ are dropped. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each DGS-1250 cooling fan (dEntityExtEnvFanStatus). ok(1) is stored as 1, fault(2) as 2; any other code is dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each DGS-1250 power supply (dEntityExtEnvPowerStatus). inOperation(1) is stored as 1; failed(2) and empty(3) are stored as 2; any other code is dropped.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
